Method of Attack: Installation of backdoors on VMware ESXi hypervisors via malicious vSphere Installation Bundles (VIBs); VirtualPita: 64-bit passive backdoor creating a listener on a hardcoded port, impersonates VMware services, allows arbitrary command execution, file upload/download, and logging control; VirtualPie: Python-based daemonized IPv6 listener on a hardcoded port, supports arbitrary command execution, file transfer, and reverse shell setup
Attack Vector: Malicious vSphere Installation Bundles (VIBs) installed on bare-metal ESXi hypervisors; Modified XML descriptor in VIB files to change acceptance level from 'community' to 'partner' to deceive trust; Use of '--force' flag to install unsigned malicious VIBs; Requires admin-level privileges on the hypervisor
